title: Related Party Disclosures
summary: Requires disclosure of related party relationships, transactions and outstanding balances, converged with IAS 24, with a genuine alignment of the Key Managerial Personnel definition to the Companies Act, 2013.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS — Converged with IAS 24, with a Genuine KMP Definitional Alignment
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 24's related party identification principles mirror IAS 24 closely. The distinctive Indian feature is that 'Key Managerial Personnel' is interpreted CONSISTENTLY with the Companies Act, 2013's own STATUTORY definition (Section 2(51)) — a more PRESCRIPTIVE list of specific roles than IAS 24's own broader, principles-based 'key management personnel' concept. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
